title: 第23章 豪礼，他给的底气！

第23章 豪礼，他给的底气！-《重生2000：撕了协议我暴富了》

阳光透过没拉严实的窗帘缝隙，像一把利刃切开昏暗的卧室，正好打在地板上散落的一件浅色碎花连衣裙上。

旁边还扔着一件深蓝色的男士西装外套。

空气里那股白茶和小苍兰的香气还没散干净，混着另一种更浓郁、更原始的味道。

宽大的双人床上，被子只盖了一半。

沈蔓趴在枕头上，眉头微微蹙着。白皙的后背大片暴露在空气里，顺着优美的肩颈线条往下，两块精致的蝴蝶骨随着呼吸轻轻起伏。

再往下，腰肢收得很细，被子堪堪遮住臀线，露出一截笔直修长的小腿。

她动了一下。

“嘶——”

沈蔓倒吸了一口凉气，眉头皱得更深了。

昨天本来就是她的第一次，感觉浑身骨头像是被拆了重装过一样，尤其是大腿内侧，酸软得连抬起来的力气都没有。

昨晚疯得太狠了。

从吧台到沙发，最后折腾到这张大床上。她连自己什么时候睡过去的都不知道。

旁边传来细微的响动。

林川靠在床头，上半身赤裸着，肌肉线条匀称结实，手里端着一杯温水，正似笑非笑地看着她。

“醒了？”

沈蔓脸一红，赶紧扯过被子把自己裹严实，只露出一颗脑袋，瞪了他一眼。

“都怪你……”声音沙哑，带着浓浓的鼻音，听起来与其说是抱怨，不如说是撒娇。

林川把水杯递过去，顺手在她鼻尖上刮了一下。

“喝点水。”

沈蔓就着他的手喝了两口，感觉嗓子舒服了一点。

“几点了？”

“快十点了。”

沈蔓猛地坐起来，被子滑落，春光乍泄。“完了完了，我中午还得回宿舍，下午还要去中队开会！”

她慌乱地想找衣服，结果刚一动，腿一软，整个人又跌回了床上。

林川眼疾手快地接住她，顺势把人捞进怀里。

皮肤贴着皮肤。

沈蔓像触电一样缩了一下，脸红得快滴出血来。“你干嘛……放开我，我真得起来了。”

林川没松手，反而更紧地扣住她的细腰，低头凑到她耳边，声音压得很低。

“洗个澡再走。”

沈蔓还没反应过来，整个人突然腾空。

“呀！你放我下来！”

在沈蔓的惊呼声中，林川直接抱着她走向浴室。

磨砂玻璃门砰地一声关上。

水声很快响起，夹杂着几声压抑的惊呼和喘息，但很快又被水流声盖了过去。

中午十二点。

银灰色的法拉利停在南山区一栋有些年头的公寓楼下。

这是航空公司给空姐租的宿舍楼。

沈蔓坐在副驾驶，手里紧紧攥着安全带。她今天换了一身林川昨晚给她买的新裙子，头发重新打理过，虽然化了淡妆，但眼角眉梢那股被滋润过的媚意，怎么都藏不住。

“我上去了。”她轻声说。

The sunlight penetrated through the cracks in the curtains that were not tightly drawn, cutting through the dim bedroom like a sharp blade, and hit a light-colored floral dress scattered on the floor.

Also thrown next to him was a dark blue men's suit jacket.

The aroma of white tea and freesia in the air has not yet dissipated, and is mixed with another stronger, more original smell.

The large double bed was only half covered by the quilt.

Shen Man lay on the pillow, frowning slightly.A large area of ​​her white back is exposed to the air, and along the graceful lines of her shoulders and neck, two delicate butterfly bones rise and fall gently with her breathing.

Further down, the waist is very thin, and the quilt can barely cover the hip line, revealing a straight and slender calf.

She stirred.

"Hiss——"

Shen Man took a deep breath and frowned deeper.

Yesterday was her first time, and she felt as if all the bones in her body had been dismantled and reassembled, especially her inner thighs, which were so sore that she didn't even have the strength to lift them up.

It was so crazy last night.

From the bar to the sofa, and finally to the big bed.She didn't even know when she fell asleep.

There was a slight noise from the side.

Lin Chuan was leaning on the head of the bed, his upper body naked, his muscles well-proportioned and strong, holding a glass of warm water in his hand, looking at her with a half-smile.

"Are you awake?"

Shen Man blushed, quickly pulled the quilt and wrapped herself tightly, leaving only her head exposed, and glared at him.

"It's all your fault..." The voice was hoarse and had a strong nasal tone. It sounded more like coquettishness than complaint.

Lin Chuan handed over the water glass and scratched the tip of her nose.

"Drink some water."

Shen Man took a few sips from his hand and felt that her throat felt better.

"What time is it?"

"It's almost ten o'clock."

Shen Man sat up suddenly, the quilt slipped off, and she had a happy moment."It's over, it's over, I have to go back to the dormitory at noon, and I have to go to the squadron for a meeting in the afternoon!"

She frantically tried to find clothes, but as soon as she moved, her legs gave way and she fell back onto the bed.

Lin Chuan caught her with quick eyes and hands, and took her into his arms.

Skin against skin.

Shen Man flinched as if he was electrocuted, and his face was so red that he almost bled."What are you doing...let me go, I really have to get up."

Lin Chuan did not let go, but held her waist tighter, lowered his head to her ear, and kept his voice very low.

"Take a shower before leaving."

Before Shen Man could react, his whole body suddenly flew into the air.

"Yeah! Let me down!"

Amidst Shen Man's exclamations, Lin Chuan carried her directly to the bathroom.

The frosted glass door slammed shut.

The sound of water sounded quickly, mixed with a few muffled exclamations and gasps, but was quickly covered up by the sound of water flowing again.

Twelve noon.

The silver-gray Ferrari was parked under an old apartment building in Nanshan District.

This is a dormitory building rented by the airline for flight attendants.

Shen Man sat in the passenger seat, holding the seat belt tightly in her hands.Today she put on a new dress that Lin Chuan bought her last night, and her hair was styled again. Although she put on light makeup, she could not hide the moisturized charm in the corners of her eyes and eyebrows.

"I'm going up," she said softly.
